answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 20 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. The pearl multiplier is published, charged in tundra, and mesa lists each payment. A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, as the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 3868 identities would post 690 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
